engineeringSkip.reason: There is no real research field of engineering materials at the femtometre scale — altering nuclear configurations is nuclear transmutation, not materials engineering, and the claimed applications (indestructible armour, extreme energy storage) have no basis in known physics.

factCheck.reason: The femtometre scale is the scale of the atomic nucleus, where structure is fixed by the strong force and can only be altered by nuclear reactions costing millions of electronvolts per nucleus — so a stable bulk material cannot be 'engineered' at that scale, and claims of indestructible armour or extreme energy storage have no basis in known physics.
